technical_and_design_decisions: Created subpackages 'pkg/configtx/orderer' and 'pkg/configtx/membership' to cleanly separate domain types without circular dependencies.
Adopted a fluent interface pattern using wrapper structs (e.g., Application, Organization, Orderer) holding references back to the parent ConfigTx struct to enable API chaining.
Renamed Base() and Updated() to BaseConfig() and UpdatedConfig() on the ConfigTx type.
Standardized all Add/Update methods to SetXXX with idempotent overwrite behavior, using deduplication logic for slice-based fields such as AnchorPeers.
Updated RemoveXXX methods to ignore missing target values and return nil errors when elements do not exist.
Utilized spf13/cobra or standard Go flag libraries to implement the configtx CLI tool for genesis blocks, channel creation transactions, and config updates.
assumptions: Development work is performed directly within the existing Hyperledger Fabric repository structure in Go.
Underlying Protocol Buffer schemas for channel configuration remain unchanged; changes are limited to the Go library and CLI wrapper.
Standard Go toolchains, godoc server, and testing frameworks are available in the build environment.

activities.activity_description: Analyze existing configtx codebase, map all Add/Update/Remove functions, design fluent chaining wrappers, subpackage structures, and CLI command hierarchy.
Convert AddXXX/UpdateXXX functions to SetXXX across configtx, implement overwrite and slice deduplication logic, rename Base/Updated functions, and update RemoveXXX to be idempotent.

Extract orderer types (BatchSize, Kafka, EtcdRaft, ConsensusState) into pkg/configtx/orderer and membership types (SigningIdentityInfo, OUIdentifier, CryptoConfig, NodeOUs) into pkg/configtx/membership.
Implement intermediate subtype wrappers (e.g., Application, Organization) and getters/setters allowing chained calls (e.g., c.Application().Org(orgName).SetAnchorPeer(...)).

Improve New() GoDoc, clean up redundant example functions, split large examples into focused ones (ACLs, policy retrieval, orderer updates, membership), remove output validation blocks, and format code lines for horizontal scroll prevention.

Implement CLI tool supporting commands and flags for genesis block creation, channel creation transactions, and config updates across all updatable config properties, including CLI documentation and tests.
Execute full unit and integration test suites, validate GoDoc rendering via local godoc server, and ensure all story acceptance criteria are fully met.
